texts: bad: the query measures the yield on a dimension called "quantity" that no word in your question supplies, so it can only match a stored fact that happens to have invented the same dimension — and "two vessels of mire-essence" (a container amount of a substance) has no settled form at all, so the count may never line up with how the yield was recorded. Say the amount as a plain count of things instead of a container measure of a substance: "Why did the cauldrons yield two mire-essence vessels on day 17 of Year 1?"
